title: Concord first-usable floor readiness manifest
description: Closed contract for the authorizing record of Concord's distance from the first-usable floor defined in docs/priorities.md. Every floor condition decomposes into bounded items whose state is one of satisfied, outstanding, unmeasured, or out_of_scope. Schema 2.0 binds every satisfied item to a typed executable anchor rather than a cited repository path.

source.description: Default provenance: the document and section the floor conditions are copied from. A condition may override this with its own source. The manifest never redefines the floor.

conditions.description: The floor conditions, in the order they appear in the source document. Every condition must carry at least one item. A condition may declare its own source to override the manifest-level source; the override has the same {path, section} shape and means 'this condition comes from here instead of the manifest-level source'.

source.description: Per-condition provenance override. Same closed {path, section} shape as the manifest-level source. When present, this condition comes from this document and section instead of the manifest-level one.

requirement.description: What must be true for this item to be satisfied. Written so it can be checked, not so it can be agreed with.

evidence.description: Typed executable anchors that prove a satisfied state. Each anchor carries a closed {kind, value} pair from the closed set {go_test, scenario, validator, generated} and is resolved by the shared evidence_anchors machinery. Repository paths are not anchors: a satisfied item cannot be established from a cited path alone (issue #187). Required when satisfied; forbidden otherwise.

issue.description: Public issue number tracking an outstanding item. Required when outstanding; forbidden otherwise.

reason.description: Why an item is unmeasured or out of scope. Required for those states; forbidden otherwise.
